sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: In the next generation phased-array systems, the Transmit/Receive (T/R) Module development will be driven by cost reduction, with performance enhancement as a boundary condition. By using microwave monolithic integrated circuits, these demands will be met. Phased array radars use up to thousands of antenna elements, generally with a T/R module per antenna element. sections.title: IMPLEMENTATION
sections.text_preview: The core chip is implemented in the 0.25pm PHEMT (PH25) process of UMS. The size of the chip is 4.5 x 5.5 mm’. A lot of attention is paid to the layout.
